artwork.title: Corridor in the Asylum
artwork.basic_description: Painted during van Gogh's stay at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum, this work depicts the corridor of the institution where the artist resided while receiving treatment.

analysis.technique: Oil on canvas, characteristic of van Gogh's expressive brushwork and vivid color palette.
analysis.historical_context: Created during a turbulent period in van Gogh's life, following the infamous ear incident.
analysis.symbolism: The corridor represents both confinement and the path to recovery, reflecting van Gogh's complex emotional state.

artwork.title: Corridor in the Asylum
artwork.basic_description: Painted during van Gogh's stay at the Saint-Paul-de-Mausole asylum, this work depicts the corridor of the institution where the artist resided while receiving treatment.

analysis.technique: Oil on canvas, characteristic of van Gogh's expressive brushwork and vivid color palette.
analysis.historical_context: Created during a turbulent period in van Gogh's life, following the infamous ear incident.
analysis.symbolism: The corridor represents both confinement and the path to recovery, reflecting van Gogh's complex emotional state.

related_insights: For a complete understanding of this work, additional analysis of van Gogh's mental state during this period is essential.
The architectural elements in this painting connect to several other works from the same period that require detailed examination.
Contemporary medical records from the asylum provide crucial context that can only be accessed through deeper analysis.
